Notes to Consolidated Financial Results - Q2 FY 2026-2027
1. The above results which are published have been reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 31st October 2026. The financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with relevant rules Issued thereunder and the other accounting principles generally accepted In India.) The unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors.

2.The above consolidated financial results have been reviewed and recommended by Audit Committee and have been approved and taken on record by Board of Directors at its meeting on 31st October 2026.

3. The limited review as required under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 has been completed by the auditors of Company.

4.During the quarter ended 30th September 2026, the Company, pursuant to the approval of its Board of Directors, sold its entire holding of 3,50,000 equity shares of Rs.10 each, representing 70% of the paid-up equity share capital of Haitek Automotive Private Limited (“Haitek”). Consequently, Haitek has ceased to be a subsidiary of Mercury EV-Tech Limited with effect from 1st July 2026.

5. Figures for the previous periods have been regrouped and/or rearranged and/or reclassified wherever necessary to make them comparable with those of current periods.

6. Basic EPS and Diluted has been Calculated with Total No. of Equity Shares held as on 30.09.2026 i.e. 18,99,73,058.
